theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.nineTenths_exponent_one :
∃ (m : ℤ), |9 / 10 - ↑m / 2 ^ 2| ≤ 1 / (2 ^ 2) ^ 1

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.nineTenths_run_approximates :
∃ (m : ℤ), |9 / 10 - ↑m / 2 ^ 2| ≤ ↑((expandState (9 / 10) 2).gap / 2 ^ 2)

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.expandState_nineTenths_runs :
Bracketed (expandState (9 / 10) 2) ∧ ∀ j < 2, ↑(expandState (9 / 10) (2 + j)).value < 9 / 10

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.expandState_half_flags :
(expandState (1 / 2) 2).hasLo = true ∧ (expandState (1 / 2) 2).hasHi = true

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.expandState_half_bracketed :
Bracketed (expandState (1 / 2) 2)

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.approx_exponent_of_run (α : ℝ) (n k t : ℕ) (hb : Bracketed (expandState α n)) (hg : (expandState α n).gap ≤ 1) (hrun : ∀ j < k, ↑(expandState α (n + j)).value < α) (hk : n * t ≤ k) :
∃ (m : ℤ), |α - ↑m / 2 ^ n| ≤ 1 / (2 ^ n) ^ t

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.expansion_run_approximates (α : ℝ) (n k : ℕ) (hb : Bracketed (expandState α n)) (hrun : ∀ j < k, ↑(expandState α (n + j)).value < α) :
∃ (m : ℤ), |α - ↑m / 2 ^ n| ≤ ↑((expandState α n).gap / 2 ^ k)

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.expandState_plus_run (α : ℝ) (n k : ℕ) :
(∀ j < k, ↑(expandState α (n + j)).value < α) → expandState α (n + k) = List.foldl GonshorState.step (expandState α n) (List.replicate k Sign.plus)

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.expandState_succ_plus (α : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (h : ↑(expandState α n).value < α) :
expandState α (n + 1) = (expandState α n).step Sign.plus

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.run_plus_approximates {α : ℝ} {st : GonshorState} (k : ℕ) (hb : Bracketed st) (hbr : Brackets α (List.foldl GonshorState.step st (List.replicate k Sign.plus))) :
|α - ↑st.hi| ≤ ↑(st.gap / 2 ^ k)

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.foldl_replicate_plus_hi (k : ℕ) (st : GonshorState) (h : Bracketed st) :
(List.foldl GonshorState.step st (List.replicate k Sign.plus)).hi = st.hi ∧ Bracketed (List.foldl GonshorState.step st (List.replicate k Sign.plus))

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.step_plus_hi (st : GonshorState) (h : Bracketed st) :
(st.step Sign.plus).hi = st.hi

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.expansion_approximates (α : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hb : Bracketed (expandState α n)) (k : ℕ) :
|α - ↑(expandState α (n + k)).value| ≤ ↑((expandState α n).gap / 2 ^ k)

theorem QOU.AppendixSurreals.expandState_gap (α : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hb : Bracketed (expandState α n)) (k : ℕ) :
Bracketed (expandState α (n + k)) ∧ (expandState α (n + k)).gap = (expandState α n).gap / 2 ^ k
